name: Synlig AEO Service
description: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for Norwegian brands. Our main product is Sitert-pakken ({{PRIS:sitert}} NOK ex. VAT): (1) a baseline measurement — five buying-intent questions from your market, nine byte-identical runs, naming whoever gets cited when you are not; (2) the changes written out for up to ten pages — JSON-LD, citable questions and answers, llms.txt, AI-crawler rules — ready to paste or as a pull request; (3) a re-measurement 30 days after you publish, before/after in one document with the raw data. Written outcome criterion: at least one citation of your domain in the follow-up runs, otherwise we run another round at no extra charge. Invoiced with 14-day terms, no meetings. Order: https://synligdigital.no/faktura?slug=priser-sitert. Synlig Lite (990 NOK) is the smallest step: FAQPage JSON-LD for one page.

skills.name: Free AEO Audit
skills.description: Instant AI-visibility audit for any business website. Returns score (0-100), grade (A-F), and prioritized recommendations. Free, no signup required. Works for any URL but tuned for Norwegian B2B SaaS.
examples: Audit the AEO score for https://example.no
How visible is this SaaS in ChatGPT and Perplexity?

endpointParams.url: required — the website URL to audit
endpointParams.format: optional — 'json' returns machine-readable JSON: totalScore, maxScore, grade, and per-component recommendations (Norwegian text). Omit for an HTML report.
endpointParams.lang: optional — 'en' renders the HTML report in English, recommendations translated. Ignored when format=json.

skills.name: Sitert-pakken (AI citation: measure, fix, re-measure)
skills.description: Measures whether AI assistants cite a Norwegian brand in its own market, writes the changes that unblock citation, and measures again. Method: five buying-intent questions, nine byte-identical runs for the baseline; changes for up to ten pages (JSON-LD, citable Q&A, llms.txt, AI-crawler rules) delivered ready to paste or as a pull request; nine more runs 30 days after the customer publishes, before/after in one document with raw data. Pricing (two packages, ex. VAT): Sitert-pakken {{PRIS:sitert}} NOK one-time (invoice, 14-day terms, no meetings) and Synlig Lite 990 NOK one-time (FAQPage JSON-LD for one page, 1 business day). Written outcome criterion: at least one citation of the customer domain in the follow-up runs, otherwise another round at no extra charge. We do not promise a ranking or a specific number of citations. Method and its limits: https://synligdigital.no/metode. Order: https://synligdigital.no/faktura?slug=priser-sitert
